stances.quote: Congresswoman Kat Cammack (FL-03) today announced that ten of her amendments were adopted in the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027 (H.R. 8800), which passed the House by a vote of 216-214. The legislation authorizes a pay raise for every service member and now advances to the Senate.
stances.reasoning: The statement supports the NDAA and service member pay raises, indicating a pro-military spending position.

stances.quote: As a member of the House Energy and Commerce Committee and its Health Subcommittee, Cammack helped shape the rural health provisions and shepherd them through the committee process as part of the Working Families Tax Cuts law.
stances.reasoning: Explicit reference to supporting the Working Families Tax Cuts law shows a position favoring lower taxes.

stances.quote: Cammack helped craft and shepherd the Rural Health Transformation Program through committee, securing more than $200 million for Florida and delivering critical resources to rural communities across FL-03.
stances.reasoning: The text highlights securing and delivering over $200 million in federal health investments, indicating support for increased government spending.
